description: ADR 0228 Otwarte 1 (review P2-113-1): forward at 15 km/h with a steady 0.57 lock until the articulation settles (~48-56 deg), then a full service-brake stop with the lock held. The laden trailer may brush the cab after the stop (known residual); the brush must stay short, shallow and below 100 kN.

checks.source: per-step velocity change <= 0.35 m/s (kerb jerk ceiling, ADR 0165 / D58)
kingpin stays in the jaw through the contact (driving limit 5 mm)
residual brush after the stop: measured 1.10 s (20 km/h) / 0.09 s (15 km/h) laden, 0 empty (review P2-113-1 bound 1.5 s)
first-step stop of a ~1 km/h closing speed: measured 75.9 kN (20 km/h) / 90.5 kN (15 km/h) laden, 0 empty (review P2-113-1 bound 100 kN)
sub-millimetre brush: measured 0.155 mm / 0.610 mm laden
